claim_boundary: Separate retrospective oracle audit. One floating CVP proposal per missing published direction, sign and frozen chart, translated only by the blindly recovered27 subgroup. Exact group words and chart identities are replayed separately. No CVP optimality, coset completeness, new point search, new curve or rank upper bound; no oracle output enters prospective centre selection.
